subject: modelling observer bias at point counts - replies

messages.subject: modelling observer bias at point counts - replies
parts:
Dear List,

Thanks for the replies. I received several helpful suggestions about
how to overcome the problem of variable effort at point counts when
trying to model the effect of observer, weather etc. on mammal sighting
frequencies. The suprisingly simple solution in this case appears to be
to run a generalised linear model, using frequency as the response
variable, observer, weather, time of night etc. as factors and
visibility as an 'offset'. This appears to be working fine. Thanks
again,

John
